notes: The shipped default, and the LOW ANCHOR of the reward scale. It keeps the final snapshot of the frozen run and nothing else, which is what a training script does when nobody has thought about retention: one file on disk, the last one written. It spends 1 of the 6 slots the storage budget allows. The verifier re-evaluates this selection from scratch on every grading run rather than reading a stored number for it, so the number your submission has to beat is measured on the same snapshots yours is.
